arithmetic/divide/int-by-list-index.reason: The index operator requires a numeric constant position; a position computed from a ternary over a document field is refused.

cast/string/from-integral-ternary.reason: The ternary's branches are int literals, which CEL renders in plain decimal ("1000000"), but the plan ships an int and a double constant as the same bare number and $toString over a double renders the exponent form ("1e+06"), so the adapter refuses string() over an untyped integral constant of 1e6 or more

cast/string/negated-from-integral-ternar.reason: Same untyped integral constant under string() as `cast/string/from-integral-ternary`, under negation

collection/except/as-lambda-body.reason: CEL needs a boolean where the dyn()-wrapped except() list stands, a no-overload error; the planner keeps the wrapper as operator `dyn`, which the adapter does not translate.

collection/except/negated-as-whole-condi.reason: CEL needs a boolean where the dyn()-wrapped except() list stands, a no-overload error; the planner keeps the wrapper as operator `dyn`, which the adapter does not translate.

collection/exists/map-keys.reason: The macro ranges over a to-one relation, which CEL reads as a map and iterates by KEY. The keys are the attribute names the application sends, which the stored subdocument does not carry: $objectToArray yields stored field names, which the mapping may rename, a null a nullable field stores is a key MongoDB keeps and CEL never sees, and a nested relation (parent.inner) is a separate mapper entry. No expression reads the key set without guessing it.

collection/exists/negated-map-keys.reason: Same key iteration over a to-one relation as `collection/exists/map-keys`, under negation.

collection/exists/two-variable-map-key-a.reason: A two-variable exists() over `obj`, a map: CEL binds each KEY and its value, and the keys are the attribute names the application sends, which no stored document carries (the mapping places `obj.inner` on the aString field, and a mapper entry may rename any key). A two-variable macro is iterated, by position, only over a reference the mapper declares a list or relation.

collection/has-intersection/deprecated-s.reason: The planner passes the deprecated has_intersection spelling through unchanged, and the adapter translates only hasIntersection.

membership/in/map-attribute-keys.reason: `in` over a to-one relation tests the related map's KEYS, the attribute names the application sends, which the stored subdocument does not carry (see `collection/exists/map-keys`: renamed fields, stored nulls CEL never sees, nested relations mapped separately).

membership/in/negated-map-attribute-keys.reason: Same key membership over a to-one relation as `membership/in/map-attribute-keys`, under negation

principal/filter/as-whole-condition.reason: CEL needs a boolean where the dyn()-wrapped filter() list stands, a no-overload error; the planner keeps the wrapper as operator `dyn`, which the adapter does not translate.

principal/map/as-whole-condition.reason: CEL needs a boolean where the dyn()-wrapped map() list stands, a no-overload error; the planner keeps the wrapper as operator `dyn`, which the adapter does not translate.

regex/matches/case-insensitive-non-ascii.reason: (?i) is passed to $regex only over ASCII letters: PCRE2 and RE2 fold other letters differently, so a (?i) pattern holding É is refused.

regex/matches/dot-all-flag.reason: The RE2-to-PCRE2 translator reads only (?: among (? groups; an inline (?s) flag is refused.

regex/matches/field-to-field.reason: $regex takes a constant pattern that the translator checks as RE2 first; a pattern read from a row would run as PCRE2, so it is refused.

regex/matches/word-boundary.reason: The RE2-to-PCRE2 translator reads only literal escapes and \d \D \w \W of the escapes both dialects share; \b is outside that subset, so the pattern is refused.

string/concatenate/negated-null-principa.reason: add(null, "canary") has no CEL overload; the adapter refuses a null constant operand to add rather than carry the error through $expr.

timestamp/equals/field-to-field-without-.reason: A bare comparison of two date_time fields: CEL compares the strings the application sent, and a stored BSON date has discarded the lexical spelling (two spellings of one instant are equal dates and unequal strings). Refused in the filter and in the three-valued evaluation alike; compare timestamp(...) values instead.

type-mismatch/has-intersection/negated-a.reason: hasIntersection against a map is a CEL no-overload error, and the adapter translates hasIntersection only against a literal list.

type-mismatch/matches/list-literal-patte.reason: matches() is translated only with a constant string pattern; a list pattern is a CEL no-overload error.
